retention: Original captures, definition/method documents, discovery catalogues, rejected matches and dated audit inputs are retained for reproduction. Empty/failed attempts are explicitly marked and supply no invented observations.
limits: This inventory describes the relevant quantitative project models and their acquisition/audit evidence; it does not claim every paragraph of every PDF was converted.
Archive paths may be locally available but excluded from Git; receipts alone cannot recreate missing source bytes.
Source IDs can have multiple dated captures. Paths and checksums preserve those distinctions.
Island resident allocations do not imply complete walking, facility or scheduled public-transport coverage.
